parameter_schema.label: mode
parameter_schema.description: Operating mode. STANDARD100kbit/s is a proposed baseline, not minimum clock frequency. UFm is a different unidirectional push-pull system.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: endpoint role
parameter_schema.description: Actual endpoint role. A pure controller needs no own target address; controller-target does.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: controller id
parameter_schema.description: Actual canonical clock-owning controller identity. No invented ECU identity or topology owner confirmation.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: device source
parameter_schema.description: Actual controller/target datasheet revision, supported modes, pins and address constraints.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: binding source
parameter_schema.description: Actual matching controller-target port and segment binding, with unique addresses/multiplexing evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: physical source
parameter_schema.description: Actual voltage/pull-up/driver/load/edge/threshold/segment evidence; nominal rate is not electrical validation.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: schedule source
parameter_schema.description: Actual transactions, register/address phases, polling/retry/stretch/arbitration and functional acceptance evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: drive
parameter_schema.description: Actual driver. Sm/Fm/Fm+ wired-AND open drain/collector; HS controller current source; UFm push-pull.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: address bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual7/10-bit target address width, no inferred7-bit hardware configuration.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: target address
parameter_schema.description: Actual unshifted target address, excluding R/W. Reserved7-bit purposes require explicit matching service evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: address purpose
parameter_schema.description: Actual ordinary versus reserved service addressing; general call/START/HS code/prefix are not interchangeable targets.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: address source
parameter_schema.description: Actual device straps/register/assigned address and reserved service meaning; unknown, no automatic0x20.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: direction
parameter_schema.description: Actual transaction direction. UFm accepts writes only; bidirectional requires combined address phases.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: multi controller
parameter_schema.description: Actual competing controller configuration. Arbitration is unnecessary for a proven single controller, not assumed false.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: clock stretch supported
parameter_schema.description: Actual matched controller/target stretching support. UFm cannot stretch; HS stretches only after ACK.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: hs entry rate bps
parameter_schema.description: Actual F/S-mode HS controller-code entry clock. HS3.4M data rate cannot size this preceding phase.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: hs controller code
parameter_schema.description: Actual reserved8-bit HS controller code00001XXX; code8 reserved test/diagnostic, not a target address.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: hs diagnostic
parameter_schema.description: Actual test/diagnostic use permitting controller code8; no implicit operational use.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: stretch position
parameter_schema.description: Actual stretch placement: HS only after ACK, UFm none. Stretch upper bound is device/schedule data, not a spec default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: ack policy
parameter_schema.description: Bidirectional ACK/NACK is not CRC or functional acceptance. UFm preserves ninth pulse HIGH without target acknowledgement.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: vdd v
parameter_schema.description: Actual pull-up/driver supply domain; no universal3.3/5V.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: vil max v
parameter_schema.description: Actual receiver LOW threshold, including legacy fixed-level parts and level translators.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: vih min v
parameter_schema.description: Actual receiver HIGH threshold, not universally inferred from current CMOS ratios.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: vol max v
parameter_schema.description: Actual worst-case driver LOW at actual current/voltage/temperature.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: voh min v
parameter_schema.description: Actual UFm push-pull HIGH guarantee; passive open drain HIGH is pull-up/leakage/load evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: sink bound ma
parameter_schema.description: Actual safe sink capability at specified VOL, not automatically3mA/20mA.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: source bound ma
parameter_schema.description: Actual UFm source capability or HS current-source qualification; not passive pull-up current.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: pullup ohms
parameter_schema.description: Actual passive pull-up for Sm/Fm/Fm+; Rp minimum depends on sink and VOL, maximum on rise time and capacitance. No4.7k default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: bus cap pf
parameter_schema.description: Actual per-line wire+pins+connectors capacitance. Table11 limits400/400/550pF, HS100..400 interpolated timing; UFm no generic capacitance maximum.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: pin cap pf
parameter_schema.description: Actual pin capacitance. Ordinary qualified device max10pF; switches/multiplexers can exceed with explicit device evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: special pin
parameter_schema.description: Actual special switch/multiplexer exception, unknown; prevents falsely applying ordinary10pF limit.
parameter_schema.source_revision: NXP UM10204 Rev7.0 2021-10-01 sections3/5/6/7 Tables10-15

parameter_schema.label: extended frequency bound bps
parameter_schema.description: Actual verified section7.2 load/drive/RC/segmentation frequency bound, never an automatic higher mode or unspecified relaxation.

parameter_schema.label: extended source

parameter_schema.label: bus clear

parameter_schema.label: recovery source

parameter_schema.label: retry limit

parameter_schema.description: Actual pure versus legacy mixed bus. Mixed requirements cannot be inferred from an industry name.

parameter_schema.description: Actual canonical active controller identity; handoff changes ownership explicitly.

parameter_schema.description: Actual device model/datasheet/revision and limits.

parameter_schema.description: Actual matching GETCAPS/BCR/DCR/GETMXDS support and optional mode negotiation.

parameter_schema.description: Actual controller/target ports, bus segment and unique assigned addresses.

parameter_schema.label: binding source

parameter_schema.description: Actual voltage, driver, keeper/pull-up, capacitance, stubs and edge timing proof.

parameter_schema.label: physical source

parameter_schema.description: Actual initialization, address arbitration, IBI, handoff, retries, transfer layout and deadlines.

parameter_schema.description: Actual per-mode command/register/content-protocol, padding/integrity and transfer bound.

parameter_schema.description: Actual clock register/divider and measured/configured phase clocks, not maximum wire data rate.

parameter_schema.description: Actual Push-pull SDR/data-phase clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.

parameter_schema.label: pp clock hz

parameter_schema.description: Actual Open-drain address/arbitration phase clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: MCUXpresso SDK2.14.0 I3C_GetDefaultConfig implementation defaults
parameter_schema.label: od clock hz

parameter_schema.description: Actual Legacy I2C target phase clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: MCUXpresso SDK2.14.0 I3C_GetDefaultConfig implementation defaults
parameter_schema.label: legacy clock hz

parameter_schema.description: Actual First broadcast disabling spike filters clock. Phase rates and protocol overhead are separate; no universal operating default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: initial clock hz

parameter_schema.description: First broadcast normally uses Fm/Fm+ timing. Faster/omitted header requires actual spike-filter evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: initial header

parameter_schema.description: Actual all-target accurate-filter or no-filter evidence; no automatic omission of first broadcast.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: initial filter source

parameter_schema.description: Actual negotiated data lanes; SDR multilane belongs to full I3C, not Basic.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: lanes

parameter_schema.description: Actual matched controller-target support for selected HDR mode, not capability of a different part.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: hdr supported

parameter_schema.description: Actual clock drive: SDR controller push-pull; mode-specific clock handoff requires actual capability.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: scl drive

parameter_schema.description: Actual phase-specific SDA drive; OD arbitration/address is separate from PP data.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: sda phase

parameter_schema.description: I3C targets and compatible legacy targets cannot stretch SCL; controller low extension is different.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: target stretch

parameter_schema.description: Actual legacy target 50ns spike filter, required for supported mixed buses.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: legacy filter 50ns

parameter_schema.description: Legacy I2C controllers cannot share an I3C bus.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: legacy controller present

parameter_schema.description: Actual compatible legacy Fast/Fast+ target mode, not Standard/HS/UFm.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: legacy mode

parameter_schema.description: Actual private/CCC/legacy transfer direction; no generic Ethernet duplex.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: direction

parameter_schema.description: Actual dynamic assignment method. SETDASA/SETAASA need static addresses; Hot-Join needs ENTDAA.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: address method

parameter_schema.description: Actual unshifted 7-bit unique target address. Broadcast/Hamming neighbours and legacy conflicts are excluded.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: dynamic address

parameter_schema.description: Actual optional legacy/static 7-bit address; pure I3C targets need not have one.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification
parameter_schema.label: static address

parameter_schema.description: Ordinary dynamic address or explicitly proven legacy exception; not automatic0x0A.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification

parameter_schema.description: Actual assignment and conflict-free address allocation, excluding R/W/parity bits.

parameter_schema.description: Actual8-bit DCR device capability register, not factory placeholder.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Public FAQ v1.2 updated2025-09-04 incl pending errata; not the complete normative specification

parameter_schema.description: Actual BCR limitation bit advertised by target.

parameter_schema.label: mode
parameter_schema.description: Actual serial mechanism, unknown. A stream/COM-port name alone selects neither UART nor synchronous clocks nor native USB CDC.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: transport binding
parameter_schema.description: Required actual registered serial/USB/PHY port and direction topology reference; no silent RS232/RS485/SPI binding.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: implementation source
parameter_schema.description: Required device/firmware/clock/driver capabilities and revision, unknown. Generic Serial is an NIS abstraction, not a normative serial bus.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: framing source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual message encoding/framing/escaping/integrity and byte/character boundary source, unknown; stream chunks are not necessarily complete messages.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: uart profile
parameter_schema.description: Explicit source-qualified async UART framing profile, unknown. TB3216 tutorial supplies conditional9600/8N1 proposals, not universal baud minimum.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: baud rate
parameter_schema.description: Actual async binary UART symbol rate, unknown until matched clock/divisor/configuration;9600 is conditional tutorial proposal, not generic minimum.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: peer baud rate
parameter_schema.description: Actual peer configured baud rate; must agree with selected UART configuration. Clock error/oversampling tolerance needs actual device proof.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: data bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual data bits per UART character; reviewed AVR5..9, tutorial8. Not application octets or USB packet size.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: parity
parameter_schema.description: Actual UART parity; reviewed AVR NONE/EVEN/ODD only, tutorial NONE. Other devices require their own source.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: start bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual UART start bits; reviewed AVR/tutorial1. Unknown device-specific layouts are not verified using AVR limits.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: stop bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual UART stop-bit periods; reviewed AVR1 or2, tutorial1. Fractional stop periods are device-dependent.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: char bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual start+data+parity+stop bit-periods per character. Tutorial8N1=10, AVR parity adds1. Not8 useful bits.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: encoded characters
parameter_schema.description: Actual serialized character count including framing/encoding/escaping/flow characters as applicable, unknown; not blindly equal to application payload octets.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: wire bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual UART occupied bit-period count = encoded characters times character bits; start/stop/parity included.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: serialization us
parameter_schema.description: Actual UART serialization time = wire bit periods / binary UART baud times1e6, excluding actual gaps/flow stalls.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: gap bound us
parameter_schema.description: Actual aggregate character/message/turnaround idle bound, unknown; zero only when explicitly justified.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: flow control
parameter_schema.description: Actual UART flow control and peer support, unknown. No automatic disabled flow-control assumption.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: flow bound us
parameter_schema.description: Actual bounded UART flow-control blocking from both endpoints, unknown. Unbounded peer stalls do not prove capacity.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: wire bound us
parameter_schema.description: Actual complete UART transfer bound at least serialization+aggregate idle+flow stalls, unknown; driver/application processing remains separate.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: clock hz
parameter_schema.description: Actual synchronous serial clock, unknown. Encoding/bits per clock/edge/role/word lengths supplied by actual bound port; never UART baud or USB speed.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: cdc line coding role
parameter_schema.description: Actual CDC implementation interpretation of line coding, unknown. Arduino native CDC ignores Serial.begin baud for wire speed; USB-to-UART bridges require separate real UART binding.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: framing
parameter_schema.description: Actual application message framing, unknown; optional line delimiters in TB3216 example are not mandatory for all serial streams.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: message bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual application-message octets, unknown. Not API read/write chunk, UART characters, USB packets or encoded wire count.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: max message bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual implementation/application-message limit, unknown.65535 is not a generic serial standard maximum.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

parameter_schema.label: profile
parameter_schema.description: Actual selected implementation/revision scope. Public FSK rules do not certify C8PSK, WirelessHART or HART-IP.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: phy
parameter_schema.description: Actual wired modulation. FSK standard baseline1200bit/s; C8PSK9600bit/s is a different mode requiring actual matched modem. HART-IP/WirelessHART need separate transport paths.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: revision
parameter_schema.description: Actual peer universal-command revision, unknown. Polling range and command capability must match it; not automatically latest7.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: role
parameter_schema.description: Actual sending endpoint role, unknown. Requests originate at host; response/burst at field device.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: host role
parameter_schema.description: Actual interacting host identity, unknown. Primary/secondary arbitration and quiet times differ; not universal primary master.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: binding source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual registered modem/port/current-loop binding and both endpoint capabilities, unknown.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: device source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual device description/revision/commands/preamble and response behavior, unknown.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: physical source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual impedance/cable/power/coupling/modem/IS/filtering evidence, unknown; nominal FSK rate does not prove installation.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: schedule source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual host arbitration, command turnaround, retry/burst and complete transaction schedule evidence, unknown.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: mode
parameter_schema.description: Actual request/response or device-supported enabled burst mode, unknown. Generic multicast is not wired HART burst.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: frame kind
parameter_schema.description: Actual frame direction/category; status and delimiter differ between request and field response/burst.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: address format
parameter_schema.description: Actual encoded short1-byte or long5-byte address; long unique identity is distinct from polling number.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: address bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual address field octets: short1, long5. No arbitrary2/3/4-byte encoding.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: poll address
parameter_schema.description: Actual device polling number, unknown: rev5-or-earlier0..15, rev6+0..63. Point-to-point0 is a proposal, not a real device assignment.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: topology
parameter_schema.description: Actual current-loop topology, unknown. Multidrop analog fixed-current behavior requires actual revision/device configuration.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: expanded device type
parameter_schema.description: Actual14-bit expanded device type in qualified long-address layout, unknown; not an automatically generated device identifier.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: device id
parameter_schema.description: Actual24-bit device ID in qualified long-address layout, unknown; host and burst flags are separate.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: preamble bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual transmitted0xFF preamble octets in public FSK profile. Peer-specific required length and detection loss matter;5 is not a safe default for every unknown peer.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: peer preamble bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual required preamble length learned from matching field device, unknown. Configured transmit preamble must be at least this.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: delimiter
parameter_schema.description: Actual delimiter octet; qualified FSK encodes address length, expansion count and frame category. C8PSK delimiter rules not inferred from asynchronous FSK.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: expansion bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual encoded expansion bytes matching delimiter. Normal0 proposal belongs to qualified public FSK layout; future extensions need revision evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: command
parameter_schema.description: Actual wire command octet, unknown. Command31 carries extended16-bit command in data; command support and response semantics remain device-specific.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: extended command
parameter_schema.description: Actual16-bit extended command when wire command31, unknown; its two bytes must be included in transmitted data length, not extra hidden overhead.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: command source
parameter_schema.description: Actual supported command, request/response data layout, units and encoding source, unknown. Generic data length does not prove functional command compatibility.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: status bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual status length: request0, field response/burst2 in qualified FSK layout.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: data bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual encoded data octets excluding response status, including extended-command bytes when present. Request/response layouts differ; no8-byte default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: byte count
parameter_schema.description: Actual byte-count field = data plus status octets, excluding checksum. Response data at most253 when status2; not a universal complete255-byte frame limit.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: checksum bytes
parameter_schema.description: One transmitted XOR checksum octet in qualified public FSK layout; checksum covers delimiter through data, excluding preamble. Numeric length is not executed integrity evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: checksum source
parameter_schema.description: Actual XOR calculation and observed parity/byte stream evidence, unknown; no auto-confirmed checksum or authentication.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: wire octets
parameter_schema.description: Actual whole frame incl preamble/delimiter/address/expansion/command/count/status/data/checksum. Separate from data and byte count.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: char bits
parameter_schema.description: FSK asynchronous character:1start+8dataLSB-first+odd parity+1stop=11bits. These bounds apply only to selected qualified FSK profile; not generic8N1.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: wire bits
parameter_schema.description: Actual serialization bits including all qualified FSK characters, not payload×8. C8PSK encoded stream needs actual physical evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: serialization ms
parameter_schema.description: Actual frame serialization time from complete encoded bits and selected physical rate, excluding turnaround/gaps/arbitration; not whole transaction latency.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: gap us
parameter_schema.description: Actual worst inter-character gap; qualified FCG FSK rule requires less than one11-bit character time. No universal gap0 default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: slave timeout chars
parameter_schema.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK slave timeout28character times; timeout is not actual device processing latency or application deadline.
parameter_schema.source_revision: FieldComm character-time support article2016-11-11

parameter_schema.label: hold chars
parameter_schema.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK HOLD2character times, separate from frame serialization and actual modem turnaround.
parameter_schema.source_revision: FieldComm character-time support article2016-11-11

parameter_schema.label: link grant chars
parameter_schema.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK link grant RT2=8character times.
parameter_schema.source_revision: FieldComm character-time support article2016-11-11

parameter_schema.label: quiet chars
parameter_schema.description: Qualified FieldComm2016 FSK RT1 primary33/secondary41character times. Master identity must be explicit.
parameter_schema.source_revision: FieldComm character-time support article2016-11-11

parameter_schema.label: response start ms
parameter_schema.description: Actual request-end to response-start upper bound incl device and modem, unknown; qualified FCG timeout relation applies. Does not include response duration.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: retry limit
parameter_schema.description: Actual host/device retry budget, unknown; no inherited CAN0 or Siemens client-specific universal value.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: retry bound ms
parameter_schema.description: Actual total additional retry/arbitration recovery bound, unknown. Per-message or transport-independent timeout cannot substitute.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: burst supported
parameter_schema.description: Actual endpoint burst capability confirmed by device source, unknown; enabling mode must not fabricate support.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: burst period ms
parameter_schema.description: Actual device/revision configured burst schedule, unknown. Tutorial3-4updates/s is illustrative, not a universal standard period.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: loop load ohms
parameter_schema.description: Actual loop receiver resistor/communication load for qualified TI FSK example230..600Ohm, typically250. Bounds are not universal total loop impedance; device-specific topology requires actual source.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: loop supply v
parameter_schema.description: Actual loop supply and device compliance budget, unknown; not a universal24V supply.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: loop current ma
parameter_schema.description: Actual operating analog loop current, unknown;4..20mA measurement range and multidrop fixed current are not arbitrary digital defaults.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: signal pp ma
parameter_schema.description: Actual FSK signal amplitude at matched load, unknown.1mApp is nominal tutorial value, not measured endpoint evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: cable cap pf
parameter_schema.description: Actual cable/receiver capacitance and length/loading bound, unknown; not I2C400pF or an inferred universal cable length.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: is required
parameter_schema.description: Actual hazardous-area/intrinsic-safety requirement, unknown; HART name does not imply certified safe installation.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: is source
parameter_schema.description: Actual matched barriers/entities/cable/loop intrinsically-safe certification evidence, unknown; separate from message checksum.
parameter_schema.source_revision: TI SLAAEH0 November2023 sections1.1-1.5 pp2-9; FieldComm character-time support article modified2016-11-11; full licensed HART specifications not read

parameter_schema.label: profile
parameter_schema.description: Reviewed two-wire voltage-mode H1 baseline proposal. Optical/media extensions require their own physical evidence; HSE Ethernet is a different transport.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: configuration source
parameter_schema.description: Required matched specification/firmware/network configuration reference, unknown.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: csource
parameter_schema.description: Required matched device CFF capability file/version, unknown. Capacity, timer and block constraints are not universal defaults.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: physical source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual segment cable/power/terminator/repeater/signal/intrinsic-safety evidence, unknown.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: schedule source
parameter_schema.description: Required actual LAS/VCR/block execution/communication schedule evidence, unknown. Schedule feasibility is not implied by bitrate.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: layout
parameter_schema.description: Qualified FMS/FAS/data-transfer diagram layout. Control PDUs and fragmented logical domains need their own definition.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: pdu
parameter_schema.description: Actual link PDU, unknown. Native control traffic is not an FMS data-transfer packet.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: fms pci bytes
parameter_schema.description: Four-octet FMS PCI proposal only for reviewed FMS DT layout.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: fas pci bytes
parameter_schema.description: One-octet FAS PCI proposal only for reviewed FMS DT layout.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: dl sdu bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual data-link SDU, equals FMS encoded payload plus FMS/FAS PCI in reviewed DT layout. Priority ceiling applies to DLSDU, not payload.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: dl pci bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual data-link PCI, unknown; reviewed DT diagram range5..15 octets. Not a universal overhead8.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: fcs bytes
parameter_schema.description: Two-octet frame-check sequence baseline proposal. A declared size does not recompute or verify integrity.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: ph sdu bytes
parameter_schema.description: Actual complete DL PDU/physical SDU, including DL PCI/SDU/FCS. Reviewed FMS diagram range8..273; excludes physical delimiters/preamble.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: preamble bytes
parameter_schema.description: Baseline one-octet preamble proposal; actual repeaters may require extension. Lower baseline does not prove physical synchronization.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: start bytes
parameter_schema.description: One-octet-equivalent physical start delimiter proposal, includes non-data symbols; not an Ethernet preamble.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: end bytes
parameter_schema.description: One-octet-equivalent physical end delimiter proposal; not an Ethernet interframe gap.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: wire octets
parameter_schema.description: Actual physical telegram sum including preamble/start/end. Excludes idle/response/token exchanges and block execution; not whole transaction latency.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: priority
parameter_schema.description: Actual native DLL urgency, unknown. Qualified DLSDU ceilings64/128/256 bytes respectively; no CAN ID or Ethernet PCP conversion.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: vcr
parameter_schema.description: Actual VCR model. Buffered scheduled publication differs from queued client/server or source/sink token traffic.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: access
parameter_schema.description: Actual native access mechanism. CD scheduled publication; PT unscheduled token passing. Not generic FIFO arbitration.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: buffering
parameter_schema.description: Actual VCR storage semantics; buffered publisher/subscriber is not a queue. Queue capacity remains actual CFF configuration.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: device class
parameter_schema.description: Actual device class, unknown. BASIC cannot become LAS; link master and bridge have capability, not automatic active status.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: las active
parameter_schema.description: Actual LAS active state, unknown. Exactly one active LAS per link requires topology/runtime evidence; not auto true.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: las owner
parameter_schema.description: Actual LAS node identity, unknown. LAS service address4 differs from configured physical node address.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: las service address
parameter_schema.description: Reserved LAS service address4 baseline; does not allocate node address4 to an ordinary device.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: node address
parameter_schema.description: Actual8-bit node address, unknown. Operational range16..247 differs from cleared248..251 and temporary252..255; LM/BASIC allocation uses actual FUN/NUN.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: address state
parameter_schema.description: Actual address allocation category, unknown. A random commissioning address is not a persisted operational default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: fun
parameter_schema.description: Actual boundary of link-master address pool, unknown. Not hard-coded16 or vendor sample20.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: nun
parameter_schema.description: Actual unused address count, unknown. BASIC start=FUN+NUN; actual address availability must be checked.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: link address
parameter_schema.description: Actual logical link16-bit identifier, unknown; may be omitted within a link, needed across bridge.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: selector
parameter_schema.description: Actual8-bit selector, unknown. DLCEP and DLSAP reserved allocation depends on VCR and device CFF, not just scalar range.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: vcr index
parameter_schema.description: Actual device-local VCR index, unknown; device-specific capacity and supported index allocation require CFF.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: pd tag
parameter_schema.description: Actual physical-device readable tag, unknown. Tag identity differs from numeric network address.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: sm state
parameter_schema.description: Actual system-management state, unknown. SM_OPERATIONAL is not inferred from address or selected profile.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: macrocycle us
parameter_schema.description: Actual configured communication/block macrocycle microseconds, unknown. No universal100ms CAN/application-cycle default.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: scheduled us
parameter_schema.description: Actual total scheduled communication occupied window microseconds. Complete CD/DT/response gaps and other scheduled traffic must be included by schedule source.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: unscheduled us
parameter_schema.description: Actual available unscheduled budget microseconds, unknown; cannot be treated as zero merely because schedule is absent.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: maintenance us
parameter_schema.description: Actual maintenance/synchronization/probing and remaining reserved macrocycle budget microseconds. Budget partition must sum to declared macrocycle.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: publish offset us
parameter_schema.description: Actual publication offset within macrocycle microseconds, unknown; not block execution completion proof.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: exchange bound us
parameter_schema.description: Actual bounded complete scheduled transaction duration microseconds including CD/DT/gaps/response. Wire telegram duration alone is insufficient.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: token hold us
parameter_schema.description: Actual granted PT token holding interval microseconds, unknown. Different from scheduled DT and NIS request timeout.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: response bound us
parameter_schema.description: Actual matched CFF/device response bound normalized to microseconds, unknown. Native timer units require source conversion; no sample-device value copied.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: cable type
parameter_schema.description: Source-recommended Type A shielded twisted-pair baseline proposal. B/C/D are source reference wiring profiles, not automatically accepted installation designs.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: trunk m
parameter_schema.description: Actual trunk length, unknown. Total segment includes all spurs; nominal1900m Type A is an upper reference limit, not a default length.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: spurs total m
parameter_schema.description: Actual summed spur lengths, unknown. Per-spur/device-count/reference limits and IS constraints require actual topology source.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: segment total m
parameter_schema.description: Actual trunk plus summed spurs. Qualified reference limits A1900/B1200/C400/D200m; DEVICE_SPECIFIC requires own verified bounds.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: terminators
parameter_schema.description: Baseline two end terminators proposal, not evidence that wiring has two. Different media require their own realization.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: termination ohm
parameter_schema.description: Nominal100ohm end termination proposal. Actual impedance/tolerance and capacitive coupling require source.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: terminal v
parameter_schema.description: Actual received device voltage, unknown. Reviewed voltage-mode envelope9..32V does not certify selected device/IS barrier operating limits.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: supply ma
parameter_schema.description: Actual available power-conditioner/barrier current budget, unknown. Not inferred from32-node illustration.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: devices ma
parameter_schema.description: Actual total device current including limits/reserves, unknown; must fit available current. Individual voltage drops still require evidence.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: power source
parameter_schema.description: Actual voltage-drop/current-budget/power-conditioner/isolator calculation source, unknown.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: is required
parameter_schema.description: Actual intrinsic-safety requirement, unknown. It does not claim SIL/safety communication or explosion protection.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification

parameter_schema.label: is source
parameter_schema.description: Actual matched intrinsic-safety barrier/device/cable certificate and entity/FISCO design evidence, unknown; required when IS selected.
parameter_schema.source_revision: Yokogawa TI38K02A01-01E third edition April2012 sections2.1.2/2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/3.5.2; manufacturer tutorial, not full normative specification
